description: Orkest canonical Codex hooks — reconciled into .codex/hooks.json by bin/orkest-init / ghostdev-update. Every handler goes through bin/orkest-hooks (Python 3) so apply_patch is checked per file. Codex asks you to trust each new or changed hook once (/hooks).

hooks.command: bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/bin/orkest-hooks.sh" run --engine codex tdd-test-gate
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "& (Join-Path $(if ($r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null) { $r } else { $PWD.Path }) 'bin/orkest-hooks.ps1') run --engine codex tdd-test-gate; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

hooks.command: bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/bin/orkest-hooks.sh" run --engine codex session-fingerprint
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "& (Join-Path $(if ($r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null) { $r } else { $PWD.Path }) 'bin/orkest-hooks.ps1') run --engine codex session-fingerprint; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

hooks.command: bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/bin/orkest-hooks.sh" run --engine codex orkest-startup
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "& (Join-Path $(if ($r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null) { $r } else { $PWD.Path }) 'bin/orkest-hooks.ps1') run --engine codex orkest-startup; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
